subject: Agriculture
title: China's Pork Empire
description: A quick win: understand China's Pork Empire.

hook.text: China has half the world's pigs—over 400 million. Pork is the foundation of Chinese cuisine.

buildup.text: The Chinese character for 'home' combines the symbols for roof and pig. Pigs define domesticity.

discovery.text: As China industrialized, backyard pigs moved to mega-farms with 100,000 animals under one roof.

twist.text: African swine fever killed a quarter of China's pigs in 2019—roughly 150 million animals wiped out.

climax.text: The loss spiked global pork prices and reshaped meat trade worldwide. One country's disease rattled markets.

punchline.text: When half the world's pigs sneeze, the global economy catches cold.

quiz.question: What happened to China's pig population in 2019?
options: African swine fever killed roughly a quarter—about 150 million pigs
